description: This file provides utility functions for reading and writing JSON data to and from files, including functions for serializing Go structs to JSON with indentation and deserializing JSON content back into Go variables.

methods.name: WriteJsonSerializableToFile
methods.description: Serializes a Go data structure to indented JSON and writes it to a specified file.

methods.name: ReadFileAsJson
methods.description: Reads JSON content from a file and unmarshals it into the provided output variable.
